text:
Tracking is emailed when your order ships, and it can take **up to 24 hours** to update after that. So if the link was sent recently, it's normal for it to show nothing yet.

If the tracking still hasn't moved after **4 business days**, contact us and we'll open a courier investigation, which can take up to **5 business days**. If the parcel turns out to be lost, you can choose a free replacement or a full refund.

Also, if it shows as delivered but nothing has arrived, contact us and we'll open the same kind of investigation.

If you haven't received a shipping email at all, I can't see your order details from here, so tell me your order number (it looks like LF-123456) and I can point you to next steps or escalate to a Support Lead.
